regions.region: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao

rule_register.signal: Official ABC per km ≥ same-subtype P95
rule_register.evidence: Transparent cost outlier; requires official PhilGEPS/DPWH ABC, parsed length and ≥30 peers; excluded for slope works

rule_register.signal: Official ABC per km P90–P95, or ABC ≥ P95 when length unavailable
rule_register.evidence: Screening statistic; benchmark provenance limits interpretation

rule_register.signal: Any prior contractor termination (years before target)
rule_register.evidence: OR 1.51 (95% CI 1.05–2.17) in 2020–25 matched sample; termination is not misconduct

rule_register.signal: Recent (≤3 yrs) or high-rate (≥2% of ≥5) contractor termination
rule_register.evidence: OR 2.08–2.69 but threshold chosen after inspecting data; promoted only after ≥30 independent human decisions
Not rare (16% historically); not associated with later termination (OR 0.55–0.70)
Weights review order by potential exposure: Large ≥ ₱100m, Medium ≥ ₱25m

rule_register.signal: Missing PhilGEPS notice or missing fields
rule_register.evidence: Coverage problem, not a project characteristic

validation.item: Official ABC via PhilGEPS reverse index

validation.result: 31 blinded cases; did not improve a weak legacy rule → AI kept out of scoring

gates.name: Data health
gates.text: Bulk scan, detail retrieval and PhilGEPS joins are checked each run; failures are reported, never scored.

gates.name: Queue capacity
gates.text: At most 8 new cases a day plus 1 random baseline case; excess cases wait, none are dropped.

gates.name: Human decision
gates.text: Every case needs one decision label and a written reason from a reviewer.

gates.name: Rule change
gates.text: Rules change only by a pull request approved by a person, after the evidence gate is met.

agents.name: Scout
agents.purpose: Scans the full DPWH project list every run and maintains persistent state of the current-year road-procurement population.
agents.must_never: Treat a project's appearance or disappearance as evidence of anything; rewrite unchanged state.
agents.gate: G1 data-health: run aborts its outputs if the bulk scan fails

agents.name: Matcher
agents.purpose: Builds a reverse index of open mPhilGEPS notices and joins DPWH Contract IDs to official bid notices to obtain the ABC.
agents.must_never: Accept an ABC from an ambiguous or conflicting notice; treat a no-match as adverse.

agents.name: Profiler
agents.purpose: Builds each bidder's DPWH road-project history using only years before the target project.
agents.must_never: Infer ownership, political or social links; use the target project's own outcome.

agents.name: Benchmarker
agents.purpose: Compares official ABC per km with same-subtype peer thresholds.
agents.must_never: Use the DPWH project budget as procurement ABC; compare per km for slope works or with fewer than 30 peers.

agents.name: Screener (policy engine)
agents.purpose: Applies the versioned rule register to produce a review priority, a materiality band and a watch marker.
agents.must_never: Score single-bidder status, office concentration, missing data or political context.
agents.gate: Rule changes only through an approved pull request (G4)

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.purpose: Selects today's human-review cases under a capacity cap and adds one random baseline case for evaluation.
agents.must_never: Exceed analyst capacity; drop an eligible case (it stays pending).

agents.name: Verifier
agents.purpose: Checks whether each queued case's rule signals are supported by its evidence packet and writes a plain-language case note.
agents.must_never: Raise or change priority; use outside facts; describe anyone as corrupt; invent signal or source IDs.
agents.gate: Output validator rejects unknown IDs; failure degrades to 'AI unavailable'

agents.name: Review desk
agents.purpose: Opens one private GitHub Issue per queued case and posts the daily digest.
agents.must_never: Publish case-level information outside the private repository.
agents.gate: G3 human decision label + reason on every case

agents.name: Steward
agents.purpose: Weekly: turns human decisions into yield statistics by queue type and signal, against the random baseline.
agents.must_never: Change a rule; it only reports whether the pre-registered evidence gate (30 decisions) is met.
agents.gate: G4 opens a pull request that a person must approve

agents.name: Studio
agents.purpose: Publishes aggregate-only monitoring, governance and validation views to the public dashboard.
agents.must_never: Show contract IDs, contractor names or case-level flags.
agents.gate: Privacy check fails the build if an ID-like string appears
